name: WANTED: Old Rot-Chum
summary: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz offers a reward for proof of Old Rot-Chum’s demise. The aggressive murloc has been attacking small vessels in the southern waters.

sections.title: A Threat at Sea
sections.body: Sailors and swimmers in the waters to the south face attacks on rowboats and other small vessels. Local fishermen call the aggressive murloc behind them Old Rot-Chum. Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz offers a reward for proof that the creature is dead, and asks you to bring it to him.

faq.answer: Old Rot-Chum is the nickname local fishermen give an especially aggressive murloc.

faq.q: Where has Old Rot-Chum been seen?
faq.answer: Old Rot-Chum has been seen in the waters to the south, near islands infested with murlocs.

faq.q: What has Old Rot-Chum been attacking?
faq.answer: Old Rot-Chum has been attacking rowboats and other small vessels.
Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz offers a reward in exchange for proof of Old Rot-Chum’s demise.

faq.q: What proof does Whizzbuzz ask for?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz asks you to bring proof of Old Rot-Chum’s demise.
